sourceNote: Transcribed and translated in full to English from a scanned SEE (Grade Increment) 2081 (2025) Computer Science (Optional Second) question paper, code GI-3031. Only the English wording printed on the paper is used here (this is a Grade Increment / supplementary exam, distinct from the earlier regular SEE 2081 paper RE-3031 already converted). The paper did not state which province issued it, so 'province' is left null - please confirm. 'examBoard' is set to the generic 'SEE' as no specific board name was printed. Page 1 contains a visible watermark/overlay text reading 'FB - Tuition Class of Rajan Shrestha' printed over question 3; this is not part of the original exam content and has been excluded from the transcription. No other figures, flowcharts, or diagrams appear in this paper, so no items include an image field. Full marks (50) reconcile exactly against the printed section-wise marks breakdown (Group A = 10, Group B = 24, Group C = 16).

blocks.heading: SEE (Grade Increment) 2081 (2025) Computer Science - Optional Second
blocks.paragraph: This is the SEE Grade Increment 2081 (2025 AD) question paper for Computer Science, Optional Second subject, paper code GI-3031. It carries full marks of 50 and an allotted time of 2 hours, divided into Group A (short, one-line answers and terminology), Group B (short/medium answers including QBASIC program tracing and debugging), and Group C (numerical conversions and full program-writing questions in QBASIC and C).

questionSections.title: Group B - Q5: Dry run the given program

items.source: SEE Grade Increment 2081 (2025) Computer Science Optional II
items.question: Write down the output of the given program and show it in a dry run table.
items.code:
DECLARE SUB Result (A$)
A$="Development"
CALL Result (A$)
END

SUB Result (A$)
FOR C=1 TO LEN(A$) STEP 2
  X$=MID$(A$,C,1)
  PRINT X$
NEXT C
END SUB

questionSections.title: Group B - Q6: Correct the bugs in the given program

items.source: SEE Grade Increment 2081 (2025) Computer Science Optional II
items.question: Rewrite the given program after correcting the bugs.
items.code:
REM to display records
OPEN "marks.dat" FOR INPUT AS #1
CLS
PRINT "Roll Number", "Name", "English", "Nepali"
DO WHILE NOT EOF( )
  INPUT #1, RN, N$, E, Ne
  DISPLAY RN, N$, E, Ne
WEND
CLOSE
END
